scripts.build: npm run build -w @vernissage/viewer && npm run build -w @vernissage/generator
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/schema && tsc --noEmit -p packages/viewer && tsc --noEmit -p packages/generator
scripts.demos: npm run build && node packages/generator/dist/cli.js build demos/davinci --out out/davinci && node packages/generator/dist/cli.js build demos/loc-photographs --out out/loc-photographs && node packages/generator/dist/cli.js build demos/svg-masterpieces --out out/svg-masterpieces
scripts.studio: npm run build && npm run start -w @vernissage/studio
